CCNA Certification Study Guide, Volume 2, Exam 200-301

(Sybex, 2020), book pages 465 to 494. It covers why IPv6 exists, address format and shortening, address types, special addresses, manual addressing, EUI-64 and stateless autoconfiguration, DHCPv6, the IPv6 header, ICMPv6 and neighbor discovery, and IPv6 static routing, with configuration and verification. Every difference from the book is tagged and listed in the Changes and Gaps Log.

Packet Too Big (used by path MTU discovery)
The source sends packets up to its link MTU. If a router on the path has a smaller MTU, it drops the packet and sends back a
message (ICMPv6 type 2) with the allowed size. The source then sends smaller packets. This is how IPv6 avoids fragmentation by routers.
Do not block ICMPv6 with ACLs or firewalls. Blocking it breaks neighbor discovery, SLAAC and path MTU discovery.

How many bits is an IPv6 address, and how is it written?
128 bits, as eight groups of four hex digits separated by colons - Each group is 16 bits.
2001:db8::12:0:0:1 - Compress the first of two equal-length runs of zero groups. (script)
B - A has two ::, C has too few groups, D has an invalid hex digit g.
What is the modified EUI-64 interface ID of MAC 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E?
021a:2bff:fe3c:4d5e - Insert FFFE and flip the 7th bit. (script)
What is the EUI-64 interface ID of MAC FC:99:47:75:CE:E0?
A MAC starts with 3C. What does its EUI-64 interface ID start with?
B - FE80::/10 covers fe80:: to febf::.
What kind of address is fd12:3456:789a::1?
Unique local - It lies inside FC00::/7. (script)
What is the IPv6 loopback address and what is the unspecified address?
Name the three IPv6 communication types.
Unicast, multicast, anycast - There is no broadcast.
An anycast packet is delivered to...
A. Every device with the address
B. The nearest device with the address
Which multicast address do hosts use for a router solicitation, and which ICMPv6 type is it?
FF02::2, type 133 - All routers on the link.
Which multicast address does a router advertisement go to, and which type is it?
FF02::1, type 134 - All nodes on the link.
Which prefix length must an advertised SLAAC prefix have?
RA flags are A=1, M=0, O=1. Which method is this?
SLAAC for the address and stateless DHCPv6 for other settings (such as DNS) - M=1 would mean stateful DHCPv6.
What is the solicited-node multicast address for 2001:db8:acad:1:21a:2bff:fe3c:4d5e?
ff02::1:ff3c:4d5e - FF02::1:FF plus the last 24 bits. The Ethernet MAC is 33:33:ff:3c:4d:5e. (script)
How long is the IPv6 basic header and how large is the Flow Label field?
40 bytes; 20 bits - The book says 24 bits, which is wrong.
Which IPv6 header field replaces the IPv4 TTL?
Hop Limit - It is reduced by 1 at every router.
Which Next Header value identifies ICMPv6?
Neighbor discovery using ICMPv6 NS and NA - Types 135 and 136.
How many DAD neighbor solicitations does a host normally send by default?
One - The book says three, which is out of date.
What command lets a Cisco router forward IPv6 packets?
You type ipv6 address 2001:db8:acad:5::/64 on a router interface and get a subnet router anycast warning. Why?
The interface ID is all zeros - Use eui-64 or add a host part.
What does the L entry mean in show ipv6 route?
A local /128 route for the router's own address - The book wrongly calls it the link-local address.
ipv6 route ::/0 <next hop or interface> - It matches everything.
What makes a static route a floating static route?
A higher administrative distance than another route to the same prefix - For example AD 150 against OSPF 110.
Which three migration methods move a network from IPv4 to IPv6?
Dual stack, tunnelling, translation - Dual stack is the most common.
